diagram_candidates.claim: The elementary cup-cap diagrams d_i satisfy the square, adjacent triple, and distant commutation relations; stacking removes a closed cycle with coefficient δ, and product convention places the left factor above the right.
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The statement is a compact list of geometric relations, while the proof counts loops and exterior matchings in stacks. Small before/after panels can make the distinct loop contribution and the adjacent three-strand path changes easier to verify.
diagram_candidates.specific_content: Draw d_i as top cap and bottom cup at adjacent positions. Show d_i stacked with itself reducing to one d_i plus a closed circle weighted δ; show d_i d_{i+1} d_i=d_i and its reflected counterpart with the three strands and stacking order marked; show distant d_i,d_j commuting when |i-j|>1. Use the source convention that the left factor is above the right.
diagram_candidates.mathematical_status: The rendered equations and source claims were checked; no relation, label, or rendering defect was confirmed. The diagram is explanatory.

diagram_candidates.claim: Every finite planar pairing endomorphism diagram is a product of elementary cup-cap diagrams without an intermediate closed cycle; the proof moves adjacent cap-through symbols CT→TC and builds nested cap islands.
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The proof has a constructive sequence of local diagram transformations that is currently described in prose. A short schematic can clarify which boundary matching changes at each multiplication and why the intermediate stack remains a path rather than a loop.
diagram_candidates.specific_content: For the top swap, depict d_i stacked above the flat diagram changing cap at (i−1,i) plus through endpoint i+1 into cap (i,i+1) plus through endpoint i−1; state left multiplication and unchanged lower matching. Give the reflected bottom operation by right multiplication. For a cap island of 2q points, illustrate simple adjacent caps and stacking d_{i+1}d_{i+3}…d_{i+2q−3} to make the outer cap while leaving q−1 interior adjacent caps; mark no closed component.
diagram_candidates.mathematical_status: The source provides the boundary pairings, products, and no-cycle path checks; no generation or rendering defect was confirmed.

diagram_candidates.claim: Restriction of W_{n,t} along TL_{n−1}⊂TL_n has a short exact sequence with submodule W_{n−1,t−1} given by states where site n is a defect and quotient W_{n−1,t+1} given by cutting the arc (m,n) and changing m to a defect; the sequence need not split.
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The exact sequence and its two inverse basis operations are topological and benefit from a representative link-state picture. The source explicitly distinguishes a filtration from a splitting.
diagram_candidates.specific_content: Draw the inclusion by adding a rightmost vertical strand. In a representative state with rightmost site n a defect, remove that defect and its top endpoint to show W_{n−1,t−1}→U. In a quotient representative with arc (m,n), cut that arc and turn m into the new rightmost defect to show W_{n,t}/U→W_{n−1,t+1}; indicate the inverse attachment and label the sequence 0→W_{n−1,t−1}→Res W_{n,t}→W_{n−1,t+1}→0 as not asserted split.
diagram_candidates.mathematical_status: The exact sequence, basis maps, and non-splitting caveat are source-backed; no map-direction or rendering defect was confirmed.

diagram_candidates.claim: The framed Kauffman evaluation uses a fixed positive crossing convention and local difference-skein rule P(L+)−P(L−)=s(P(L0)−P(L∞)), with L0 the oriented smoothing at a positive crossing and L∞ the other smoothing; curls and trivial circles have stated factors.
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The ItemBody fixes a convention that is easy to reverse accidentally and explains it textually with cyclic endpoint labels. A small convention picture could reduce ambiguity when reading the four local diagrams.
diagram_candidates.specific_content: Draw a four-ended disk with cyclic labels 1,2,3,4; specify L+ with 1 over 3 and strand 2 over 4 according to the source description, then show crossing reversal L−, oriented smoothing L0, and alternate smoothing L∞ with their endpoint pairings. Add a separate positive/negative framing curl and a disjoint trivial-circle factor d. Preserve the exact signs and do not substitute a different skein normalization.
diagram_candidates.mathematical_status: The source conventions and displayed equation were checked; no sign or rendering defect was confirmed. This is an optional convention aid.
